# tcpsystems/hetzner-mcp

> Model Context Protocol (MCP) server (`mcp-hetzner`) for Hetzner Cloud project management with strict credential isolation and loopback/bearer transport guards.

## Core Rules
- Resolves `HCLOUD_TOKEN` or `HCLOUD_CONTEXT` at startup; never exposes credentials to agents
- Refuses non-loopback HTTP listener binding without `MCP_AUTH_TOKEN` (`cmd/mcp-hetzner/guard.go`)
- Entry point: `cmd/mcp-hetzner` (`stdio` default and streamable `http` transports)
- Packages: `internal/auth`, `internal/catalog`, `internal/server`
- Operating Rules: [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md), [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md)
